QuestInfo.name: Starting and Completing Quests
QuestInfo.0: Learn how to start and complete quests from Mai.
QuestInfo.1:
Learn how to start and complete quests from Mai.

#b#eTip:#n Click on people with #i3800569# icons to start their quests. Click on people with #i3800570# icons to complete quests. 
Some quests can be started and completed through #i03800265#.#k
QuestInfo.2:
Mai taught you how to start and complete quests.

#b#eTip:#n Click on people with #i3800569# icons to start their quests. Click on people with #i3800570# icons to complete quests. 
Some quests can be started and completed through #i03800265#.#k

0.0: Someone's talking to me? This is the best day ever! Did you know, us #btalking#k right now is actually a #bQuest#k, and completing #bQuests#k is the key to becoming a great hero? I learned that at Hero School!
0.1: Click on people with #i3800569##blightbulb icons#k over their heads to start quests. You must be some sort of genius to have figured that out for yourself! It took me two semesters to master that skill.
0.2: Remember to click people with this icon #i3800570# over their heads, too. That's how you turn in quests and get your rewards. I've read all about it in textbooks, though it's a little advanced for me.
0.3: Later, when you're higher level, you can also click the lightbulb icon #i03800265# on the left side of the screen to grab new quests. Just gimme a few years, and I'll reach that level myself!
0.4: Since you've been so nice and let me talk for five whole minutes without running away, I want to give you a present!

yes.0: This next step is really, really tough! You have to #bclick#k OK, and then the quest completion icon #i3800570# over my head to finish the quest. Don't worry if you don't get it on your first--

no.0: You're so silly! You have to click #bYes#k to accept my gift! But I guess, if someday you want to refuse someone's quest, it's all right to practice pressing #bNo#k.

1.0: HOLY RIBBON PIGS! You have amazing upper body strength! With talent like that, you owe it to the world to complete LOTS of quests. Just use the hotkey #b[Q]#k to see what quests are available!
1.1: Some'll be a cinch. Others might be a bit tougher. But they'll all be appropriate for your level. Click the #i3800569# icon when you're in the mood to do quests.
1.2: Now here's the gift I promised you! I hope it doesn't collapse when you use it, like the last few times...

yes.0: I made the #b#t3010000##k myself, with stickers and love! When you sit in chairs, you'll recover health more quickly. It took me half a year to master the technique. It's all in the wrist.
yes.1: Now, I want to tell you all about #bhunting#k. It's totally frightening, but most quests require it. I'll meet you where the #bmonsters#k are.
yes.2: Just take the #bportal#k to the right. And remember... Feet first! Don't try to dive into the portal like I did the first few months.
